notes.title: Spooky Typing is here!
notes.content:
Hey ho, guys and gals!

[h1]Spooky Typing was released!!![/h1] 

[h2]Buy Spooky Typing now![/h2]
Spooky Typing, is our scary typing game! You will have to dodge enemies while you destroy them by typing words from our vocabulary that has almost 5.5k words!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791870/Spooky_Typing_The_Ghost_Plague/]Check out now Spooky Typing Store Page![/url]

notes.title: Jump and cast spells by typing on our new game!
notes.content:
Hey ho, guys and gals!

[h1]Typomancer was released!!![/h1] 

[h2]Buy now our Typing Platformer![/h2]
Typomancer, is our arcade game that mixes Typing and Platforming, you will have to type to reload your feather and control the world around you while you destroy enemies and avoid bullets! Our vocabulary has almost 5.5k words!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714300/Typomancer_in_the_Feathers_Way/]Check out now Typomancer's Store Page![/url]
